motivation.msg02: Showing up is most of the work — nice work being here.
motivation.msg03: One focused minute beats zero perfect minutes.
motivation.msg04: Your future self will thank you for this session.
motivation.msg05: Progress is built from ordinary days like this one.
motivation.msg06: Listen once, remember twice — keep going.
motivation.msg07: Consistency beats intensity. You are building consistency.
motivation.msg08: Every rep strengthens the habit, not just the skill.
motivation.msg09: Curiosity counts as practice too — stay curious.

settings.showWatchPanelHelp: Puts the floating panel back at the bottom-right of the YouTube page and expands it. Use this if you moved it off-screen or it vanished after an extension update. Have a YouTube tab open, then click here and switch to that tab (refresh it if the panel still does not appear).

progress.journeySubtitle: Your rank is the milestone — XP is momentum — achievements are trophies along the path.
progress.xpGuideIntro: XP rewards real practice and habits. It does not come from achievements themselves — trophies unlock when you hit milestones.
progress.xpGuideEarnPractice: Practice time: 1 XP per full minute of saved-video playback in a visible tab. The focus setting also requires YouTube to have focus. Seconds save about every 30 seconds and when you leave the page.
progress.xpGuideEarnDaily: Daily goal met: +25 XP once per calendar day when you have a daily goal set (Goals tab) and you reach it. Granted on the next practice save after the goal is met.
progress.xpGuideEarnStreak: Streak day: +10 XP once per day when your streak is 2+ days and today already has at least 1 full minute of credited practice (60+ seconds).
progress.xpGuideEarnComplete: First completion: +15 XP the first time you mark a library video complete (once per video).
progress.xpGuideMultiWeekend: Weekend: 2× practice XP on local Saturday and Sunday (shown as “2× weekend XP active” when it applies).
progress.xpGuideMultiPrestige: Prestige: +5% practice XP per prestige level, up to +50% at prestige 10. Bonuses and first-complete XP are not multiplied.
progress.xpGuideRankBody: Your rank is computed from cycle XP. Each rank needs more XP than the last; the ring and bar show progress within your current rank toward the next. At rank 120 you can prestige (see below).
progress.xpGuideCycleBody: Cycle XP is your current prestige run — it sets your rank and can reset to 0 when you prestige. Lifetime XP is the running total across all cycles and never goes down.
progress.xpGuideAchievementsNote: Achievements are separate badges (library size, hours watched, streaks, rank, prestige). They do not grant XP; they celebrate what you already did.
progress.prestigeReadyLead: You've reached Rank 120 — ready to prestige?
progress.prestigeReadyHint: Reset your rank to 1 and start a new cycle. You keep achievements, library, practice history, and settings. Gain +5% practice XP per prestige (up to +50%).
progress.confirmPrestige: Enter Prestige? Your cycle rank resets to 1 and cycle XP goes to zero. Lifetime XP, achievements, library, and practice history are kept.
progress.prestigeFailed: Could not prestige. Reach Rank 120 first.
